title: A truly amazing way to explore gorgeous Barcelona!
text: This was such a fantastic experience! The tour guide was extremely friendly and knowledgeable and gave a very personalized tour of the city to me, taking me to special places and giving me unique insights I never would have gotten with a big generic tour or with a self-guided jaunt. I highly recommend this for a first-time visitor both to get your bearings in the city, as well as to get gems that no one else but a well-educated local can give you about the city's history, politics, ethnicity, and culture!
author: Sharon_D

title: A great intro
